description: Given a chunk (its document_id + chunk_index, e.g. from a search result), return the surrounding chunks — the N before and N after — plus their combined text. The classic RAG move: search finds one chunk, this widens the window so the model has the context around it.

inputs.name: document_id
inputs.description: The document the anchor chunk belongs to

inputs.name: chunk_index
inputs.description: The anchor chunk's index (e.g. from a search result)

inputs.name: knowledge_base
inputs.description: The knowledge base, from a Knowledge Base node. If omitted, falls back to the flow's default knowledge base.

inputs.name: before
inputs.description: How many chunks before the anchor to include

inputs.name: after
inputs.description: How many chunks after the anchor to include

inputs.name: separator
inputs.description: Joins chunk contents in the combined output

outputs.name: chunks
outputs.description: The window of chunks, ascending by index

outputs.name: content
outputs.description: The window's chunk contents joined by the separator

outputs.name: count
outputs.description: Number of chunks in the window
